name: echidna-llm-mcp
description: ECHIDNA 105-prover invocation surface — discovery, proof, verification, tactic suggestions, interactive sessions

backend.description: ECHIDNA REST API — all 15 tools route here

provers: Agda, Coq, Lean, Isabelle, Z3, CVC5, Metamath, HOLLight, Mizar, PVS, ACL2, HOL4, Idris2, Lean3, Vampire, EProver, SPASS, AltErgo, FStar, Dafny, Why3, TLAPS, Twelf, Nuprl, Minlog, Imandra, GLPK, SCIP, MiniZinc, Chuffed, ORTools, TypedWasm, SPIN, CBMC, SeaHorn, CaDiCaL, Kissat, MiniSat, NuSMV, TLC, Alloy, Prism, UPPAAL, FramaC, Viper, Tamarin, ProVerif, KeY, DReal, ABC, TypeLL, KatagoriaVerifier, TropicalTypeChecker, ChoreographicTypeChecker, EpistemicTypeChecker, EchoTypeChecker, SessionTypeChecker, ModalTypeChecker, QTTTypeChecker, EffectRowTypeChecker, DependentTypeChecker, RefinementTypeChecker, OrdinaryTypeChecker, PhantomTypeChecker, PolymorphicTypeChecker, ExistentialTypeChecker, HigherKindedTypeChecker, RowTypeChecker, SubtypingTypeChecker, IntersectionTypeChecker, UnionTypeChecker, GradualTypeChecker, HoareTypeChecker, IndexedTypeChecker, LinearTypeChecker, AffineTypeChecker, RelevantTypeChecker, OrderedTypeChecker, UniquenessTypeChecker, ImmutableTypeChecker, CapabilityTypeChecker, BunchedTypeChecker, TemporalTypeChecker, ProvabilityTypeChecker, ImpureTypeChecker, CoeffectTypeChecker, ProbabilisticTypeChecker, DyadicTypeChecker, HomotopyTypeChecker, CubicalTypeChecker, NominalTypeChecker, Abella, Dedukti, Cameleer, ACL2s, IsabelleZF, Boogie, Naproche, Matita, Arend, Athena, LambdaProlog, Mercury, Nitpick, Nunchaku

tools.name: echidna_list_provers
tools.description: Tool-discovery endpoint. Returns all 105 prover backends with name, tier, and complexity metadata. Always call this first to get valid prover IDs for other tools.

tools.name: echidna_health
tools.description: Health check. Returns { status: 'ok', version } if the ECHIDNA backend is reachable.

tools.name: echidna_rank_provers
tools.description: Returns all 105 prover backends with tier and complexity scores. Sort by tier ASC, complexity ASC to select the most appropriate prover for a given domain. Advisory — same data as echidna_list_provers.

tools.name: echidna_aspect_tags
tools.description: Returns the active aspect-tag set used by the tactic suggestion model. Tags categorise proof goals by domain (arithmetic, induction, rewriting, etc.).

tools.name: echidna_prove
tools.description: Invoke a prover backend on proof content. Returns { success, goals, message }. Parses the content, runs the prover, and reports verification outcome.

prover.description: Prover backend ID. One of 105 values — call echidna_list_provers for the full list. Common: Agda, Coq, Lean, Isabelle, Z3, CVC5, Idris2, FStar, Dafny, Why3, Metamath, Vampire, SPASS, EProver.

content.description: Proof content in the target prover's syntax.

neural.description: Enable Julia ML neural premise selection. Default true.

tools.name: echidna_verify
tools.description: Verify proof content (parse → export → prover binary round-trip). Returns { valid, outcome, goals_remaining, tactics_used }. Outcome is one of PROVED, NO_PROOF_FOUND, INVALID_INPUT, UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE, TIMEOUT, INCONSISTENT_PREMISES, PROVER_ERROR, SYSTEM_ERROR.

prover.description: Prover backend ID. Call echidna_list_provers for the full list of 105 values.

content.description: Proof content in the target prover's syntax.

tools.name: echidna_verify_raw
tools.description: Invoke the prover binary directly on raw content, skipping the internal parse/export round-trip. Required for provers that produce non-standard output (EProver, CaDiCaL, MiniSat, etc.). Returns { valid, exit_code, stdout, stderr, message }.

prover.description: Prover backend ID. Call echidna_list_provers for the full list of 105 values.

content.description: Raw proof content to pass directly to the prover binary.

tools.name: echidna_suggest
tools.description: Neural tactic suggestions from the Julia ML layer (corpus-backed, GNN-guided). Returns { suggestions: [string] }. These are corpus-derived and not formally verified — advisory only.

prover.description: Prover backend ID. Call echidna_list_provers for the full list of 105 values.

content.description: Current proof state or partial proof in the target prover's syntax.

limit.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return. Default 5.

tools.name: echidna_suggest_tactics
tools.description: Aspect-tag model tactic suggestions for a proof goal (goal text in, ranked tactics out). Advisory only — results are hints, not verified; they cannot influence ECHIDNA trust levels (invariant proved in abi/EchidnaLlm/Protocol.idr).

goal.description: Proof goal text in the target prover's syntax.

prover.description: Target prover ID. Call echidna_list_provers for the full list of 105 values. Common: Agda, Coq, Lean, Idris2, Isabelle, FStar, Dafny, Z3, CVC5, Why3, Vampire.

active_tags.description: Aspect tags to activate (filters suggestions by domain). Call echidna_aspect_tags for available tags.

top_k.description: Number of tactic suggestions to return (1–50, default 5).

tools.name: echidna_search
tools.description: Keyword search over the ECHIDNA proof corpus (66,674 proofs across 16 prover systems). Returns matching proof examples useful for tactic inspiration.

query.description: Search query (keywords, tactic names, theorem types).

tools.name: echidna_search_theorems
tools.description: Theorem-specific search with full metadata (name, prover, source). Complements echidna_search when you need structured theorem records rather than raw proof text.

query.description: Theorem name fragment, keyword, or mathematical concept.

tools.name: echidna_session_create
tools.description: Start an interactive tactic proof session. Returns { session_id }. Use the session_id with echidna_session_apply to apply tactics one at a time.

prover.description: Prover backend ID. Call echidna_list_provers for the full list of 105 values.

tools.name: echidna_session_state
tools.description: Get the current proof state for an interactive session. Returns { goals, complete }.

tools.name: echidna_session_apply
tools.description: Apply a tactic to the current goal in an interactive session. Returns { success, complete, goals_remaining, message }.

tactic.description: Tactic to apply (in the prover's syntax).

tools.name: echidna_session_tree
tools.description: Retrieve the current proof tree for an interactive session as a JSON structure.

tools.name: consultant_qa
tools.description: Compose a markdown Q&A response for echidnabot's Consultant mode. Pulls related corpus precedent (/api/search) and tactic hints (/api/tactics/suggest), formats both into a single markdown answer block. Used when a Consultant-mode repo gets an `@echidnabot` mention on a PR comment.

repo.description: Full repo name (owner/name) — currently used only in logging/provenance.

pr_number.description: PR number the question was posted on.

question.description: The user's question, with @echidnabot mentions stripped.

context.description: Compact summary of recent verification jobs on this PR.
